title: Code for: Single-cell profiling of living human brain identifies myeloid states associated with six-month functional outcome after intracerebral hemorrhage
description: Analysis code for the forthcoming Nature Medicine paper 'Single-cell profiling of living human brain identifies myeloid states associated with six-month functional outcome after intracerebral hemorrhage'. Scripts reproduce all main and supplementary figures. See the GitHub repository for full documentation and system requirements.
